templates.name: Verify email
templates.subject: Verify your Buyniverse email
templates.headline: Verify your email
body: Hello {{recipient_name}},
Confirm this email address to finish setting up your Buyniverse account.
body_es: Hola {{recipient_name}},
Confirma este correo para terminar de configurar tu cuenta de Buyniverse.

templates.name: Welcome
templates.subject: Welcome to Buyniverse
templates.subject_es: Te damos la bienvenida a Buyniverse
templates.headline: Your workspace is ready
body: Hello {{recipient_name}},
Your {{workspace_name}} workspace is ready. You can now discover, source and collaborate securely.
body_es: Hola {{recipient_name}},
Tu espacio {{workspace_name}} está listo. Ahora puedes descubrir, abastecer y colaborar de forma segura.

templates.name: Sign-in code
templates.subject: Your Buyniverse sign-in code
templates.subject_es: Tu código de acceso a Buyniverse
templates.headline: Use this one-time code
templates.headline_es: Usa este código de un solo uso
body: Hello {{recipient_name}},
Enter {{otp_code}} to continue signing in. It expires {{expires_at}}.
body_es: Hola {{recipient_name}},
Ingresa {{otp_code}} para continuar el acceso. Expira {{expires_at}}.

templates.name: Two-factor code
templates.subject: Your Buyniverse verification code
templates.headline: Verify your sign-in
body: Hello {{recipient_name}},
Use {{otp_code}} as your second factor. It expires {{expires_at}}.
body_es: Hola {{recipient_name}},
Usa {{otp_code}} como segundo factor. Expira {{expires_at}}.

templates.name: Password recovery
templates.subject: Reset your Buyniverse password
templates.headline: Reset your password
body: Hello {{recipient_name}},
We received a request to reset your password. This link expires {{expires_at}}.
body_es: Hola {{recipient_name}},
Recibimos una solicitud para restablecer tu contraseña. Este enlace expira {{expires_at}}.

templates.name: Password changed
templates.subject: Your Buyniverse password was changed
templates.subject_es: Tu contraseña de Buyniverse fue modificada
templates.headline: Password changed
body: Hello {{recipient_name}},
Your password was changed {{occurred_at}}. If this was not you, secure your account immediately.
body_es: Hola {{recipient_name}},
Tu contraseña se modificó {{occurred_at}}. Si no fuiste tú, protege tu cuenta de inmediato.

templates.name: Confirm email change
templates.subject: Confirm your new Buyniverse email
templates.subject_es: Confirma tu nuevo correo de Buyniverse
templates.headline: Confirm your new email
body: Hello {{recipient_name}},
Confirm this new email address for your account. The link expires {{expires_at}}.
body_es: Hola {{recipient_name}},
Confirma este nuevo correo para tu cuenta. El enlace expira {{expires_at}}.

templates.name: New sign-in alert
templates.subject: New sign-in to Buyniverse
templates.headline: New sign-in detected
body: Hello {{recipient_name}},
A sign-in to your account was completed from {{device_summary}} at {{occurred_at}}.
body_es: Hola {{recipient_name}},
Se completó un acceso a tu cuenta desde {{device_summary}} a las {{occurred_at}}.

templates.name: Account locked
templates.subject: Your Buyniverse account was protected
templates.subject_es: Tu cuenta de Buyniverse fue protegida
templates.headline: We protected your account
body: Hello {{recipient_name}},
We temporarily locked your account after unusual activity. Follow the secure recovery process to regain access.
body_es: Hola {{recipient_name}},
Bloqueamos temporalmente tu cuenta tras detectar actividad inusual. Sigue el proceso seguro de recuperación para volver a acceder.

templates.name: Social account linked
templates.subject: A social account was linked to Buyniverse
templates.subject_es: Se vinculó una cuenta social a Buyniverse
templates.headline: Identity provider linked
body: Hello {{recipient_name}},
{{identity_provider}} is now linked to your Buyniverse identity.
body_es: Hola {{recipient_name}},
{{identity_provider}} quedó vinculado a tu identidad de Buyniverse.

templates.name: Company invitation
templates.subject: You were invited to {{company_name}}
templates.headline: You have a secure invitation
body: Hello {{recipient_name}},
{{inviter_name}} invited you to {{company_name}} as {{role_name}} with {{scope_name}} access. Sign in with your approved identity before {{expires_at}}.
body_es: Hola {{recipient_name}},
{{inviter_name}} te invitó a {{company_name}} como {{role_name}} con acceso de {{scope_name}}. Inicia sesión con tu identidad aprobada antes de {{expires_at}}.

templates.name: Invitation accepted
templates.subject: {{recipient_name}} joined {{company_name}}
templates.headline: Membership activated
body: {{recipient_name}} accepted the {{role_name}} invitation for {{company_name}}.
body_es: {{recipient_name}} aceptó la invitación como {{role_name}} para {{company_name}}.

templates.name: Access changed
templates.subject: Your Buyniverse access changed
templates.headline: Your access was updated
body: Hello {{recipient_name}},
Your role is now {{role_name}} for {{company_name}} with {{scope_name}} access.
body_es: Hola {{recipient_name}},
Tu rol ahora es {{role_name}} para {{company_name}} con acceso de {{scope_name}}.

templates.name: Access revoked
templates.subject: Your access to {{company_name}} was removed
templates.headline: Access removed
body: Hello {{recipient_name}},
Your access to {{company_name}} was removed {{occurred_at}}.
body_es: Hola {{recipient_name}},
Tu acceso a {{company_name}} fue retirado {{occurred_at}}.

{{company_name}} was added to your workspace. Configure locations, roles and controls before operating.

{{company_name}} se agregó a tu espacio. Configura ubicaciones, roles y controles antes de operar.

{{project_name}} está abierto a propuestas calificadas hasta {{deadline}}.

templates.subject: {{document_name}} was acknowledged
